target: IDMGrHlp.exe 6.43 build 18, addendum: block the helper's buy-page launch
notes: Apply to the helper that already carries the two MessageBoxA skips from the playbook.
IDMan launches the helper on a timer with an incrementing /ch argument; for /ch 3 the helper calls ShellExecuteA(hwnd, 'open', 'http://www.internetdownloadmanager.com/buy2.html', NULL, NULL, 1).
There is exactly one ShellExecuteA call site, a six-byte indirect call through the IAT slot at 0x443304.
ShellExecuteA is stdcall with six arguments, so the stub returns 0 and pops 0x18 bytes: xor eax,eax ; ret 0x18.
The checksum field at file 0x150 is recomputed by the patcher.
